pipeline_probe.scope: FlagGems calls include output allocation; native_prepared excludes allocation and RNE preparation, and is a kernel reference only

rejected_stages_only_probe.scope: FlagGems calls include output allocation; native_prepared excludes allocation and RNE preparation, and is a kernel reference only

training.scope: Four standalone forward/backward/SGD probes; not full-model training

comparison_policy.primary_tf32: PPU+FlagGems ordinary TF32 vs H100 native TF32, including timing, coordinates, confidence and training errors.
comparison_policy.primary_fp32: PPU+FlagGems strict FP32 vs H100 native strict FP32, separate table.
comparison_policy.fp32_diagnostic: FP32 drift is retained as a separate accuracy reference; it is not the TF32 cross-device consistency verdict.
comparison_policy.mixed_precision: Separate policy. Match restored modules on both platforms before treating as a comparable performance result.
comparison_policy.controls: Same model weights, inputs/features, ordered RNG draws and prediction settings; matched timing protocol and quiet devices required for performance acceptance.

reporting_policy: Every report shows H100 native FP32/TF32 and PPU+FlagGems FP32/TF32 together; same-precision comparisons remain primary. Label missing data and mixed precision explicitly.

decisions.allocation: KEEP_EXPERIMENTAL: operator outputs unchanged and same-policy PPU timing improves. TF32 cross-device model consistency is not accepted: G01/G02 RMSD exceeds 0.1 A vs H100 TF32.
decisions.tf32_unsplit_stages3: HOLD_PENDING_MATCHED_TF32_VALIDATION: previous rejection was based on FP32 drift, not H100 TF32 equivalence. Existing unsplit model runs use mixed precision and lack a matched H100 policy.
decisions.stages_only: REJECT: increasing stages while preserving original serial split slows two captured large MMs.
decisions.next_direction: Audit TF32 semantics and compare ordinary TF32 on both platforms. Reevaluate numerical candidates against H100 TF32; retain FP32 drift as separate evidence.
decisions.generalization: This candidate has not passed nine-model multi-input acceptance. Existing mixed policy still has base_20250630/G01 and base_v1/G03 counterexamples.
decisions.precision_claim: No TF32-vs-FP32 latency comparison serves as the primary performance result.

evidence_transfer.safe_alternative: Raw predictions stay on PPU; derived metrics and self-authored patches returned.
evidence_transfer.new_candidate_h100_rmsd: Upper bound from triangle inequality, not directly measured.

historical_tf32_comparison.timing_limitation: Separate processes under parallel experiment load; use quiet_precision_matrix.csv for the controlled G02 comparison. Original matrix timings are preserved.
historical_tf32_comparison.source: vendor_gemm_20260930/full_gems_summary.json; these are historical runs, not all nine models with the latest candidate.
